input.hypothesis: TARGET_EQUILIBRIUM_HOLD: the historical static construction for this identical design (candidate_id core-12564696..., artifact 3573c3b2) shows a static equilibrium with the tip at the task target (residual 1.2e-8 m) at tensions [4.130153, 1.813905, 2.101490, 3.240433] N. The previous best open-loop schedule (62ddc238) ended 1.6 N away from that on tendon_1 with terminal error 0.0342 m. If this schedule drives the four tensions smoothly from the 0.2 N pretension to that static target-equilibrium vector within 0.10 s and holds it to 0.35 s, the tip should settle onto the target and the residual tip speed should decay below 0.02 m/s.
input.interpretation: This seed is an unmeasured hypothesis built from historical static evidence only; it creates no acceptance and the static tensions are treated as numerical guesses. A single physical replay will convert it into exact measured evidence.
input.stopping_condition: Stop this initialization step once a source schedule artifact exists; it is unmeasured until an independent physical replay is run.
input.weakening_observation: Terminal error stays near or above 0.01 m, or the holding-window tip speed stays well above 0.02 m/s, or the tip trajectory rings without decaying, or the tip cannot approach the target at all - any of these weakens the equilibrium-hold hypothesis and points to a dynamic (settling) or model-mismatch limitation rather than a static one.

selected_variables: 12 flat knot-major tension offsets at knots 0.10 s, 0.21 s, 0.32 s

input.expected_observation: The search should move the final tensions toward the static target-equilibrium vector [4.13,1.81,2.10,3.24] N and reshape the mid/late input so the tip arrives with near-zero velocity: terminal error dropping from 0.0342 m toward or below 0.01 m and holding-window speed dropping from 0.068 m/s toward or below 0.02 m/s, with the improvement persisting at the physically replayed sequence.
input.fixed_conditions: Same executable candidate 15d2a97a, same task d24aeac7 (0.35 s, 0.01 s grid, target [0.29,-0.035,0.19], 0.01 m and 0.02 m/s limits, 0.05 s holding window), same 4-tendon order, start schedule 62ddc238 unchanged, inactive offsets exactly zero, all knots and the correction inside the task horizon.
input.hypothesis: CONTROL_SEARCH_WIDER_RADIUS: the previous local searches saturated their coefficients at 0.4-0.5 N while the target-equilibrium tensions are up to 1.6 N away from the reached values, and the measured step response shows a slow (about 0.5 s period) lightly damped swing. Therefore the 0.034 m / 0.068 m/s plateau is a search-radius and shape limitation rather than a physical one, and a response search with a 2.5 N coefficient limit, three knots spanning 0.10-0.32 s and three trust-region iterations around 62ddc238 can reach a sequence whose endpoint error and holding speed both satisfy the original bounds.
input.interpretation: The search evaluates real executions but its ranking metric is a research gap score, not acceptance; any candidate sequence it returns must still be replayed as a fresh complete execution before it can be selected. Failure here is bounded evidence about the searched start, knots and budget only.
input.stopping_condition: Stop when the finite 56-evaluation search returns. If its best sequence is predicted/observed to satisfy both original bounds, immediately replay it as a fresh complete execution; if not, interpret which component (endpoint vs holding speed) remains blocked before choosing another method.
input.weakening_observation: If the returned best sequence still shows endpoint error above 0.01 m or holding-window speed above 0.02 m/s, in particular if improvements stall while coefficients again sit at their limits or the trust radius collapses, the wide-radius local-response hypothesis is weakened and the remaining blocker is the local parameterisation/optimiser rather than the budget.

input.expected_observation: A complete fresh pass would have shown terminal_error_m <= 0.01, holding_max_error_m <= 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s <= 0.02 m/s in one immutable execution. The only fresh complete result shows the opposite: 0.0740 m, 0.1047 m and 0.6838 m/s, i.e. it does not even hold the initial 0.0684 m error and is still swinging at the end.
input.fixed_conditions: Executable candidate 15d2a97a (design core-12564696..., 2 segments, 4 tendons, radius 0.018 m, pretension 0.2 N) and task d24aeac7/effective bd9df2 (target [0.29,-0.035,0.19], 0.35 s, 0.01 s control grid, 0.0005 s timestep, 0.05 s holding window) with the unchanged evaluator and the unchanged 0.01 m / 0.02 m/s thresholds; original protection and every method counter preserved.
input.hypothesis: CLOSEOUT_NO_FRESH_COMPLETE_PASS: no execution in this study is a complete fresh pass of the frozen original reach-and-hold task. The evidence gathered shows the limiting mechanism is dynamic arrival/settling inside 0.35 s (a slow, weakly damped swing of roughly 0.5 s period), not demonstrated static reachability of the goal: a static target equilibrium exists on this design, but driving to it overshoots and the arm is still moving fast at the horizon.
input.interpretation: Truthful closeout. (1) The only entry of all_fresh_results, artifact 289592ae (execution_id 44f90ddf8b4c4549867917d5d15c6c0f, source 4a7879eb, simulation 06fc9d6b), is valid_failure: terminal_error_m 0.07402178904506207, holding_max_error_m 0.10466109167176951, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.6838386787264206; evaluation_validity valid, execution_complete true, solver_errors 0, force_bounds 0. (2) Its 36 samples show the initial tip at [0.333,0,0.150] (initial error 0.06837 m), the tip driven DOWN to about [0.3050,-0.0480,0.0589] at 0.21 s and returning to [0.3153,-0.0440,0.1210] at 0.35 s with tip velocity [0.027,-0.009,0.678] m/s, so the arm is a slow lightly damped swing and the commanded target-equilibrium tensions arrive far too late. (3) Historical static evidence (3573c3b2, static_construction_only, same design core-12564696...) reports a static target equilibrium at [4.130152978474259,1.8139051284080312,2.1014899944119647,3.2404328923821337] N with achieved point equal to the target and position residual 1.24e-8 m; this is a local static construction and no dynamic acceptance. (4) The best historical sequence 62ddc238 ended at tensions [2.5386,1.4468,2.1442,3.1386] N with historical 0.03419 m / 0.06801 m/s, i.e. the prior nested searches moved only about 0.4-0.5 N per stage (coefficients saturating at 0.4 and 0.5 N) and never reached the equilibrium tensions. (5) Real costs: one initialize_control call produced source 4a7879eb (no physical launch); the physical_replay request deterministically returned the existing immutable execution 289592ae (physical_launches 1, owned by that earlier run, no new launch); the warm-started mechanics proposal was rejected before scientific execution (VERIFIED_MATHEMATICAL_WARM_SOURCE_REQUIRED) and the wider-radius control_search was blocked by closeout protection, so neither consumed a launch. No claim is made of infeasibility, optimality, robustness, repeatability or hardware behaviour; the untested levers are a shape/wider-radius open-loop optimisation, an offline NLP from a valid non-warm initialization, and feedback NMPC, all of which remain open within the original boundaries.
input.stopping_condition: Stop the study: the provider budget has zero available for exploration (4 remaining requests are reserved for closeout), all_fresh_results contains exactly one complete result and it is a valid failure, and no selection of a passing execution is possible.
input.weakening_observation: This closeout would be weakened by any complete fresh execution of this task satisfying terminal_error_m <= 0.01, holding_max_error_m <= 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s <= 0.02 m/s, or by evidence that the sampled swing can be stopped at the goal within 0.35 s under an unexecuted schedule.
